faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Anna University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the Anna University Project Associate / Project Scientist posts is 14 August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate posts?
faq.answer: For Project Associate - I, the salary is Rs. 28,000/- per month. For Project Associate - II, the salary is Rs. 30,000/- per month. These positions are contractual.

faq.question: Q3. What are the educational qualifications required for the Project Scientist position?
faq.answer: To be eligible for the Project Scientist position, candidates must possess a Ph.D. in Environmental Engineering or Environmental Science, or an equivalent qualification. This is a senior research role.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive. Candidates can apply without paying any application charges.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for Project Associate / Project Scientist posts?
faq.answer: Anna University is recruiting for a total of 3 vacancies. These are distributed as one post each for Project Associate - I, Project Associate - II, and Project Scientist.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it out, and submit it via post or as specified in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Associate and Project Scientist positions at Anna University will be based on an interview. Candidates shortlisted after the initial application review will be called for the interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The positions of Project Associate and Project Scientist are contractual. This means the employment will be for a fixed tenure, as specified in the appointment letter and the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. Where is Anna University located?
faq.answer: Anna University is located in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, with the pincode 600025. The recruitment is for positions within this esteemed institution.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates from outside Tamil Nadu apply?
faq.answer: The notification does not specify any domicile restrictions. Therefore, candidates from all over India who meet the eligibility criteria are likely eligible to apply for these contractual positions.
